text:
Airflow checks at midday stayed on our minds, and it was good to get your report. We are sorry your complaint came in after a rough trip with your companion animal, and we know how upsetting it is when cabin conditions do not stay steady and your pet is stressed. Your message says the cabin got too warm and that the onboard response did not meet the care you expected for your animal.

We are taking this seriously and moving it straight through the Companion Animal Travel Desk review path. The cabin crew notes, load details, and service logs are being checked now so we can see exactly where the breakdown happened. We also want to make clear that your concern has been registered in full and will be handled under the standard claim process without delay from our side. <<FACT F117>> Please keep any follow-up material together, because a clear record helps us move faster and avoid another back-and-forth. <<FACT F111>> If your pet showed any aftereffects, please include that in your reply so the review team can match the report to the service record and act fast.

Aurelia Skyways expects prompt and respectful communication from our teams, and we are sorry this was not reflected in your experience. We are pushing for a direct resolution, and if there was a missed welfare step on board, that needs to be corrected. The goal here is not to soften the issue but to fix it and make sure the next trip is handled better from start to finish. If you are able to send any extra notes on your pet's condition after landing, that will help us complete the review cleanly.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
